title: Reinstatement Fee Tariff — Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers
content:
**Tariff item.** The reinstatement fee on a credit of Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers is charged as a separate fee entry on the credit. It is waived when the customer's Summit tier in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program waives credit service fees, and a waived fee is not recorded.

**Amount.** The reinstatement fee is one amount in US dollars to the cent. It is the fee basis multiplied once by the combined rate, and only that product is rounded to the nearest cent.

- The **fee basis** is the instrument's reinstatement fee, as a flat amount.
- The **combined rate** is one figure: the reinstatement-fee rates multiplied with one another. A combined rate of 1 leaves the fee equal to its basis.

## Tariff lines

| Line | Content |
|---|---|
| Entry | a separate fee entry on the credit |
| Basis | the instrument's reinstatement fee |
| Combined rate | reinstatement-fee rates multiplied into one figure |
| Rounding | once, to the nearest cent, on the product of basis and combined rate |
| Waiver | the customer's Summit tier waives credit service fees; no entry is recorded |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- On an instrument whose reinstatement fee is 150 US dollars, with a combined rate of 1, the fee is 150 multiplied by 1, which is 150.00.
- For a customer whose Summit tier waives credit service fees, the fee is waived and no fee entry is recorded, whatever the instrument's reinstatement fee.
